title: Home page showcase
subtitle: What the public sees on arriving at the platform, and the order in which they see it.
caption: Featured content, in scrolling order.

placementHint.home_hero: The large opening banner that scrolls. The first slide is the one visitors see on arrival.
placementHint.home_aside: The “Coming up” column beside the banner. It replaces the announcements that used to be hard-coded.

scopedNotice: Your account administers part of the editions: you only see their slides, and you cannot create content that applies to the whole platform.

empty.title: No featured content
empty.description: The home page will show its fallback background until a slide is published. Start with the opening banner.

emptyPlacement.title: Nothing in this placement
emptyPlacement.home_hero: No slide is planned for the opening banner.
emptyPlacement.home_aside: No editorial pin is planned for the “Coming up” panel.

error.refused: The save was refused. Open the slide to see what is missing.
error.forbidden: This slide is outside your administration scope.
